notes.title: THE MAGISTER IS NOW AN 'AWARD-WINNING' GAME!
notes.content:
[b]It's official. The Magister was 2021's 'Best Game About Being An Alcoholic Hallucinating Fanatical Fantasy Detective'. At least, that's the highly prestigious accolade bestowed upon The Magister by PC Invasion in its '[url=https://www.pcinvasion.com/pc-invasion-alternative-awards-2021/]Alternative Awards[/url]'.[/b] 

Here's what PC Invasion had to say: [i]"...depending on your randomized character, you might be compelled to drink every day, or visit the temple, or maybe you see enemies that don’t actually exist. Flawed protagonists are a standard, but it’s fun having something like that in a randomized game where you have to battle your own demons as well as the mystery at large."[/i]

So now you know – when it comes to games about being a boozy snoop extremist, The Magister is up there with the very best of them :)

notes.title: UPDATES: BIRD COMPANION, NEW PERKS, LEADERBOARDS AND MORE!
notes.content:
The Magister has received a couple of new updates recently so we wanted to highlight some of the new content and features that have been added to the game. 

[h3][b]BIRD COMPANION AVAILABLE FROM THE TRADER[/b][/h3]
In addition to being able to recruit a cat or dog companion, you can now purchase a bird, a falcon to be precise, directly from the trader to accompany you in battles. The falcon has the following three moves:
[list]
[*] FLY: Flies around at random. Gain a 50% chance to dodge the next attack.
[*] FLYING STRIKE: Strike the enemy for 14-28 damage. Add 7 damage for each Dodge this character has.
[*] CLAW SLASH: Deals 10 damage twice. Each hit increases the damage taken by 25% for the next 3 attacks that hit the target. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37860690/95fd282b66a33994dac747915d5fbb16132dea27.png[/img]

[h3][b]GLOBAL STEAM LEADERBOARDS[/b][/h3]
Upon completing a case, you are now awarded a Fame score depending on how well you did, and how convincing a case you managed to build against whichever suspect you accused. The Fame score is multiplied depending on which difficulty level you were playing on, and then posted to the global leaderboard, which appears on the main menu screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37860690/7110df1714937c806cafcae61ac9154e6edb5239.png[/img]

[h3][b]COLOURED TEXT[/b][/h3]
Important dialogue information is now highlighted in a different colour. This makes it much easier to identify anything you really don't want to miss at a quick glance (clues, locations, skill points etc.)  which is particularly helpful for players who have a tendency to skip text or are playing with the 'Instant Text' activated in Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37860690/873f7f398eb895db3c6e1ffe47faf545a28f9d65.png[/img]

[h3][b]10 NEW PERKS[/b][/h3]
The addition of 10 new perks takes the total number to 105. This is the list of new perks included with the latest update:
[list]
[*] TREASURE HUNTER: Random encounters are much more likely to have locked treasure chests.
[*] DREAMER: You are now able to confront your inner demons in a dream.
[*] LOOTER: Random encounters are much more likely to have extra loot lying around.
[*] FREQUENT PATROLS: All red random encounters will have an extra Guard fighting on your side.
[*] GET A GRIP: When you roll 1-3 for a 'Hallucinations' card in Tactical Diplomacy, draw a card instead.
[*] WINDWALKER: Performing a melee attack on a target that is out of range no longer reduces your damage.
[*] HYPERSOMNIA: Whenever a 'Fatigue' card is player, recover 5 HP.
[*] UNSTOPPABLE RAGE: Playing the 'Enraged' card lets you draw two cards instead of one.
[*] PEOPLE PERSON: There will only be up to two modifiers in Tactical Diplomacy attempts instead of three.
[*] CULTIST HUNTER: Your attacks deal double damage against Cultists.
[*] IT'S NOT REAL: Hallucinations in battle now appear only 50% of the time.
[/list]
[h3][b]BLUFF SUSPECTS USING TACTICAL DIPLOMACY[/b][/h3]
When you've reached a 3-Star reputation with a suspect, you now have the option to 'Bluff' them using Tactical Diplomacy and force them into an admission about their whereabouts on the night of the murder, without needing to have gathered supporting evidence. This means, theoretically at least, it's possible to complete a case without finishing all the side-quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37860690/64d703a80c48b47d7c2b9ce1a6796674075923f0.png[/img]

[h3][b]END CREDITS[/b][/h3]
When the game ends, there's now a dedicated Credits screen to enjoy! Nerdook, the game's dev, has also said any streamers who cover the game on their YouTube or Twitch channels should let him know and he'll add them to the credits in a future update. You can find various [url=https://nerdook-productions.com/]ways to contact Nerdook here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37860690/125c2eae3129043fc12b6f31fafbe26c99bb5902.png[/img]

[h3][b]AND MORE![/b][/h3]
You can find all the features, content, tweaks and fixes included in the recent updates in the patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1304770/announcements/detail/5520845108863458615]here[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1304770/announcements/detail/3091151747670291154]here[/url]. 

Thanks for playing The Magister!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Digerati]Matt | Digerati[/url]

notes.title: v 1.0.0.6 Major Update
notes.content:
v 1.0.0.6 Major Update
=====
(It's a large download, because there's a lot of new stuff...!)

- The dialogue for the entire game now highlights important information with coloured text, making it MUCH easier to parse even if you are using Instant Text/skipping the text
- Reworked the Hallucination trait: now its effects are much clearer, and it also affects Tactical Diplomacy with its own Hallucinations card
- Added global Steam Leaderboards functionality: completing cases now gives you a Fame score depending on how well you did, multiplied by the Difficulty level
- There's now a dedicated Credits screen after the game ends. If you streamed the game on Twitch or uploaded a Youtube video and would like to mentioned, get in touch with me to be added to future updates!
- If you win consecutive Tactical Diplomacy attempts, they start to have more modifiers that change the rules in different ways
- New icons for documents/books/loot that are clearer than before
- Two additional ways to get the Gambler to cooperate without playing the dice game. Arm Wrestling for Physique characters, and a riddle+question for Intelligence characters.
- The Hunting Rifle and Hammer have both been buffed significantly
- 10 new Perks: the dream event has now been moved to a Perk, making it optional during a run
- Various other smaller bug fixes/balance changes

notes.title: v 1.0.0.5 Patch
notes.content:
v 1.0.0.5 Patch
=====
- New Pet available from the trader: a Falcon! You can now choose a pet birb instead of a cat/doggo.
- You can now use Tactical Diplomacy to bluff suspects at 3 stars to force an admission: this means you can now (theoretically) complete a case without completing all the side-quests!
- Dogma cards now do not need an additional card discard to be banished
- Discarding a card for a Charge now costs 1 second
- All suspects now have unique conversation text if you confront them about their motive
- Added some additional variety to many other conversations
- Fixed infinite card draw exploit

notes.title: v 1.0.0.4 Hotfix
notes.content:
v 1.0.0.4 Hotfix
=====
- You can now hold TAB in exploration/dialogue to review your existing perks/skills
- Steamworks screenshot functionality has been restored
- Deep Breath cards now cost 0 seconds to play

notes.title: v 1.0.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
v 1.0.0.3 Hotfix
=====
- Expanded Options menu for additional Audio/Video/Gameplay options
- Added Instant Text and Slower Combat options in the menu
- Adjusted Magister-General to be friendlier
- Reminders for Leaving/Poison/Burning no longer reappear after you leave the game

notes.title: v 1.0.0.2 Hotfix
notes.content:
v 1.0.0.2 Hotfix
=====
- Rebalanced combat: 
	- Some enemy stats adjusted to be more fair (especially those with excessive Armor)
	- 'Weak Block' & 'Weak Attacks' now cost 0 seconds to play
	- 'Sing Song' is now banished instead of being deleted
	- Pet and companion max HP adjusted slightly higher
	- Inquisitor's Chain Lightning has been buffed.
- Rebalanced Tactical Diplomacy: 
	- 'Annoying' cards now have a 1 in 3 chance to draw 1 if deleted
	- 'Long Talk' also draws a card after its effect is resolved
	- 'Tell a Joke' generates 2 Empathy instead of 1
- Companions now cost 1 less Crown to hire per day: Sage/Spy reduced to 1 crown, and Mercenary is now free!
- Fixed some minor misc bugs and spelling mistakes

notes.title: v 1.0.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
v 1.0.0.1 Hotfix
=====
- Fixed a few rare crash bugs during combat.
- Loot bags will no longer give zero loot: instead, they have a small chance to give loot worth 2 Trinkets instead of 1.
- Combat slowed down slightly: enemies will now pause for an extra second before ending their turn.
- Adjusted enemy combat damage to be easier at lower levels
- Fixed a bug where the Trader's traits were not showing properly when observed carefully.

notes.title: THE MAGISTER IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]It's sleuthin' and deducin' time – The Magister has finally arrived and there's a murder to solve in Silverhurst! [/b] Step into the shoes of a Magister, gather clues, discover motives, and unmask the guilty culprit! Build a deck and use a vast array of cards to fight or negotiate! 

[list]
[*] Randomly generated murder-mystery means every playthrough is different!
[*] Use physical, weapon, and magic cards to overpower enemies in battle
[*] Master 'Tactical Diplomacy' with conversation cards for peaceful outcomes
[*] Variety of Magisters to play as, each with their own specialties and flaws
[*] Recruit an ally to help, including a cat or dog companion to fight alongside you 
[/list]
The Magister is available to purchase and download now from the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/]store page[/url][/b], and you can grab it with a 15% launch discount for a limited time. You can also pick it up on Nintendo Switch, and it'll arrive tomorrow (3rd Sept) on Xbox One.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
If you should encounter any issues or bugs while playing, you can drop a message into this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304770/discussions/0/3039355280228796119/]The Magister | Bug Reports[/url]

For a taster of what The Magister has to offer, don't forget you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716720/The_Magister__The_First_Two_Days/]download The Magister: The First Two Days for free here[/url]. It gives you the first two days of an investigation to play through (in the full game, investigations take place over 14 days).

We hope you enjoy The Magister! If you do, please leave a review – it really helps. Thank you for the support!

Matt | Digerati
